package shipping

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

type downCarrier struct{ sends int }

func (c *downCarrier) Send(Label) error {
	c.sends++
	return errors.New("carrier down")
}

func TestHiddenLimit(t *testing.T) {
	carrier := &downCarrier{}
	if _, err := NewDispatcher(carrier).Ship(Parcel{Order: "o1", Grams: 100, Country: "DE"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("a carrier that is down shipped the parcel")
	}
	if carrier.sends != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("%d attempts, want 5", carrier.sends)
	}
}
